color.note: A monochrome core carries structure and text. The secondary palette carries atmosphere. Night is the primary theme.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page ground. Text in ink, ink-muted and ink-faint reads on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Raised panels, cards and navigation bars on surface-0.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells, code blocks and input fields on surface-0 or surface-1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between sections.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mark controls, inputs and outline buttons. Holds 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text, metadata and labels on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Captions and placeholders on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: fill-ink
tokens.usage: Solid primary buttons and the highest contrast fills. It is the inverse of the ground.

tokens.name: on-fill-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill-ink.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, drawn as a 2px solid outline with a 2px offset. Holds 7:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Vermilion for hero atmospheres, accent buttons and attention. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: sun
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Amber for the highlight block behind a key word. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Soft horizon tone inside sunset atmospheres. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Pink band inside sunset atmospheres and pixel accents. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Electric blue field for glass shapes and bold slabs. Text on it uses on-cool.

tokens.name: ocean
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Deep water tone in sunset and sky atmospheres. Text on it uses on-cool.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Darkest atmosphere tone and the handle color on selection frames. Text on it uses on-cool.

tokens.name: haze
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Pale sky for orbs and light atmospheres. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Soft violet tint for glass edges and sky atmospheres. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Green for meadow atmospheres and confirmation. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Secondary palette. Yellow green for meadow atmospheres and bright tags. Text on it uses on-warm.

tokens.name: on-warm
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ember, sun, peach, rose, haze, lilac, lagoon and lime. Holds 5.8:1 or better on each.

tokens.name: on-cool
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cobalt, ocean and navy. Holds 5.6:1 or better on each.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover names and one hero word per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Landing page headlines. Set with text-wrap balance.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Mira ships static HTML and lets motion carry the story.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pages arrive instantly and animate between routes.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text and small controls.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows and metadata. Set in uppercase with a middle dot between items.

styles.name: pixel-label
styles.usage: Badges, counters and labels placed on pixel pieces.

styles.name: pixel-display
styles.usage: A single oversized pixel glyph used as a shape.

spacing.note: Steps of 4px. The pixel module of the logo sits on this scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a pixel and its neighbor, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside controls and tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small control padding and list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and the minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between content blocks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on small screens.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Boxed layout frames and cells. Corners stay square so hairlines meet cleanly.

tokens.name: radius-px
tokens.usage: Pixels and selection handles.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Compact swatches and small inner details.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and atmosphere tiles.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero tiles and large glass shapes.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tags, inputs and toggles. Every control that can be pressed or typed into.

shadow.note: Depth comes from light. Use lift for floating panels and one glow behind a hero object.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Floating panels, menus and dialogs.

tokens.name: glow-ember
tokens.usage: Warm halo behind one hero object or an accent button on hover.

tokens.name: glow-cobalt
tokens.usage: Blue halo behind glass shapes on a dark ground.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind frosted glass shapes.

tokens.name: blur-field
tokens.usage: Blur applied to gradient fields inside an atmosphere.

tokens.name: grain-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the film grain layer laid over every atmosphere with overlay blending.
